protocol: RTX5090, Windows, 128 GB RAM; context512, batch8, F32 KV, FA on; greedy, graphs/TF32/reuse off. Same prompt24, 3 fresh-KV requests of32 tokens, 31 decode forwards each. Logits export enabled.
limitations: Sequential native first, then cache12, then cache14; OS cache was not flushed.
First request warms caches; only two subsequent requests are warm. Not a P6 production benchmark or broad quality evaluation.
Comparisons are transport parity on identical graph/quants, not an independent Transformers oracle.
Other applications and OS paging affect absolute speed; CPU time does not identify its cause.
Global memory includes other processes; sampled peaks can miss transients. Request-end memory is also reported.
Mmap H2D wall time includes page faults/driver staging. Neither source_bytes nor H2D bytes measures physical SSD I/O.
